t: You're looking at the Market Memorial, a relief plaque commemorating the market that used to stand at Covent Garden. A relief means the figures and scenes are raised from the surface, so it's worth looking at the carving up close. It was made by Glynis Owen, a British sculptor. The plaque is a reminder that this area was once a working market, long before it became the busy place of shops and street performers that you see around you today.
